Pig Dice Game

Pig dice — roll or hold, bust on 1, first to 100 wins. Play against a smart computer opponent.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Roll to build your turn total.
  2. Hold to bank the points — or risk rolling on.
  3. Rolling a 1 busts: turn total lost!
  4. First to 100 wins. Beat the computer!

❓ Frequently asked questions

What are the rules?

Roll to add to your turn total, or Hold to bank it. Rolling a 1 busts — you lose the turn total.

How does the computer play?

The computer rolls until its turn total reaches 20, then holds — a classic Pig strategy.

How do I win?

First to 100 total points wins the game.

Can I lose banked points?

Your banked total is always safe — only the current turn total is at risk on each roll.
